snippet_primary: > "You can accept all major debit and credit cards, PayPal, mobile wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay, and local payment methods (e.g. iDEAL, Pix, UPI, etc) through Payhip's supported digital goods payment gateways. You can connect with multiple gateways to give customers more ways to pay at checkout. Keep in mind that payment methods vary by location and provider."
